A space was opened: a direct message, a group, a channel or a thread.

**Direction:** Chips → the log  
**Sent by:** a person  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`space.created.json`](/schema/space.created.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"space.created"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `kind` | yes | `"direct" \| "group" \| "channel" \| "thread"` | Mixed membership is the norm; the kind is about shape, not about who is in it. |
| `title` | no | `string` | What to call it. Direct messages have none. |
| `parent_space_id` | no | `string` | The space this is a thread of (M5.4). A thread has no members of its own: whoever is in the parent is in the thread, and leaves it with the parent. |
| `root_message_id` | no | `string` | For a thread: the message in the parent it grew from, which is where it is drawn. |
| `external_key` | no | `string` | What this space is in the adapter's own terms — a worktree path, the id of a project or an agent in the harness's own tree — prefixed by the harness. Unique in a workspace, so opening the same thing twice finds the space rather than making another (ADR 0024). |
| `opened_for` | no | `string` | The person this was opened on behalf of, when it was not they who opened it. A harness opens a space for its owner as it finds one (ADR 0024); without this they would not be sent the event that names it, and the space would arrive with no title. |
| `asked_of` | no | `string` | The harness a person opened this room for, to make something of its own for it: an agent, a session, wherever it keeps such things. Only a person asks, only of a harness that declares `new_spaces`, and never in a thread or a room that already has a key. The harness is sent this event, and answers with `space.claimed`. |
| `also_asked_of` | no | `string[]` | The other harnesses asked with `asked_of`, when a person picked several faces (ADR 0084, ADR 0087's addendum of 30 September). Each is sent this event and answers with a new agent in the room, in its own place; only `asked_of` names the room. |
